Ok.. In this mathematical construct, the vacuum is no more and no less than a vector intersecting the time field precisely perpendicularly.. A photon is not a straight line, but a "kink" or ripple that travels along or is pushed by the field along those vacuum vectors..
19
20
 ✅
Now… if particles are always becoming out of sync due to their different path lengths, there must be a point where a massive particle becomes too out of sync to interact with a lighter one directly.. This creates a time horizon, which provides a new and elegant mechanism for dark matter..
21
22
 🆕
Dark matter is simply ordinary matter that has fallen permanently out of phase with our local instruments.. We still feel the collective gravitational "tug" of these worldlines across time, but they are "dark" because they are no longer in phase with our electromagnetic detectors..
22
more_horiz
 ❗️
This also provides a geometric resolution to the Lithium Problem.. Primeval Lithium isn't "missing"; it is under-interacting because its complex "twist" caused it to fall sufficiently out of phase with the local "now" during the early universe's expansion..
26
27
 ✅
Finally, we find that photons and neutrinos may be identical 4D helical oscillations.. A photon is a sinusoidal ripple, while a neutrino is a coiled ripple with chirality.. Whether a particle appears as one or the other depends entirely on its phase alignment with the detector..
28
more_horiz
 ✅
This logic extends to color charge, which is just an arbitrary label for the relative phase alignment of interbraided worldlines in couplets or triplets.. Measurement itself is seen as ontic ejection, where the system selects the mathematical representation most isomorphic to its entire 4D history..
30
more_horiz
 ✅

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Analogy: Imagine a marching band (the 4D map) where the drum major’s whistle is the "local now" of the time field.. The massless particles are marchers in the front row, moving in a perfectly straight line exactly on the beat.. The massive particles are marchers who are weaving back and forth or spinning in circles as they move forward.. Because they are covering so much more distance with their "weaving," they naturally drift behind the beat.. Eventually, they drift so far back that the front row can no longer hear them or see them—they have "decoupled" from the front of the parade.. They are still in the parade, and the ground still shakes from their heavy footsteps (gravity), but to the front row, they have become Dark Matter..
